recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32566 unless a later work-group decision strengthens the SHOULD guidance or separately extends similar guidance to DeviceDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-32566 was an Applied FHIR-core Device issue, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked for a constraint or rule requiring the combination of Device version type and component to be unique across repeated versions; the final resolution rejected a computable invariant and required a SHOULD comment on Device.deviceVersion.
initial_application: Source commit a120aca3b1a775667b89ddf71cb47a17e93a55f9, linked from the Jira comments through HL7/fhir#3532, added the comment "The combination of type and component SHOULD be unique across all repetitions of version." to source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. The combined branch already contains the approved Device.deviceVersion comment. FHIR-40488 explains why older Device.version wording maps to Device.deviceVersion in current R6 source. OO minutes from 2023 record the difficulty of writing this as an invariant and support the final textual-guidance approach; targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The current authoritative Device StructureDefinition already conveys the approved SHOULD rule, and adding an invariant, changing DeviceDefinition, or adding redundant prose would exceed the final Jira scope.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Device.version to Device.deviceVersion for R6, explaining why FHIR-32566's historical Device.version wording is now applied on Device.deviceVersion.
